page.overview:
Who is Musical Ants?

The Musical Ants are minor characters in A Bug's Life.

"Sure that Flik has brought them the warrior bugs who will save their colony from the grasshoppers, the ants celebrate. Music fills the air as an ant combo plays a lively tune on instruments made of seed pods, reeds, empty snail shells, and flower trumpets."
